_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a victim of crime or a dependent of a victim who has suffered injury or loss due to criminal acts. 1. The crime should have occurred within Madhya Pradesh. Victims outside the state but residing in Madhya Pradesh are eligible for interim relief. 1. The applicant must report the crime without unreasonable delay. 1. The applicant must cooperate with authorities in investigation and rehabilitation process. 1. The annual income of the victim from all sources must not exceed ₹5,00,000. If it exceeds, compensation is limited to 50% of the prescribed amount.
